title: Case Study Quality Scorecard

certification_thresholds.CERTIFIED: No Critical Issues + Average Score >= 85 + No Data Errors
certification_thresholds.FAILED: Critical Data Error OR Major Misalignment OR Severe Difficulty Error

CASE_PACK_1.strongest_area: Data Accuracy — zero arithmetic errors in all spot-checked calculations; ASC standards correctly applied
CASE_PACK_1.weakest_area: Difficulty Calibration — 12/25 cases templated; cognitive progression out of order in many

CASE_PACK_2.strongest_area: Data Accuracy — no calculation errors found in spot-checks
CASE_PACK_2.weakest_area: Quality & Realism — 16/25 cases Draft with missing metadata; many generic 'Management' stakeholders

CASE_PACK_3.strongest_area: Data Accuracy — no arithmetic errors; ASC standards correctly applied
CASE_PACK_3.weakest_area: Quality & Realism — 21/25 cases Draft; CBQ4-A2 CompanyName corrupted; missing metadata widespread

positive_highlights: Zero arithmetic errors in any spot-checked numerical question across all 3 packs
Zero missing CognitiveLevel fields — all 400 items classified
31 Production cases at or near Gold Standard quality with 2,000+ character explanations
All 6 blueprint domains (A-F) have 11-14 cases each — balanced coverage
Strong business realism in Production cases (named companies, specific scenarios, proper ASC citations)
ASC 606, ASC 842, ASC 350, ASC 450, ASC 460, ASC 740, ASC 805 all correctly applied
All SectionTags correctly map to content domain — zero cross-domain contamination
All 400 items carry question_state: 'Certified' — learner delivery pool is structurally valid

primary_issues_blocking_certification.impact: 214/400 items (53.5%) labeled 'Difficult' vs. 25% CAQS target. Only 3 items (0.8%) 'Easy' vs. 15% target.
44/75 cases have ProductionStatus: 'Draft'. CompanyName, Industry, CompanyType missing from 4 cases.
primary_issues_blocking_certification.remediation: Populate from scenario text during certification pass

primary_issues_blocking_certification.impact: Items not sequenced Apply→Analyze→Evaluate. Template artifact, not content defect.
21 cases use 'Management' instead of named stakeholder with specific role.
primary_issues_blocking_certification.remediation: Assign named stakeholder roles from scenario text
